meta.title: Is Revolut safe? | How we protect your money
meta.description: 80+ million trust us to look after more than 67.5 billion USD of their money. Protect yours with proactive defences, then personalise your settings to stay in complete control.

content.caption: Revolut Secure
content.title: Security you can bank on
content.description: Customers worldwide trust us to look after more than 67.5 billion USD of their money. Protect yours with proactive defences, then personalise your settings to stay in complete control.

items.caption: Vlad Yatsenko, Co-Founder and CTO · Revolut
items.title: "At Revolut, security isn't just a regulatory requirement, it's a basic right. We build systems to keep your money safe — and we’re on hand 24/7 to help every single customer, worldwide."

content.title: Looking for a sign? This is it
content.description: The Revolut Secure shield is a reminder that our always-on monitoring system and dedicated, 24/7 Financial Crime team are with you. If we send you a fraud or scam warning, take note, take action, then breathe easy.

content.title: Secure from the second you sign up

items.title: Strict identity checks
items.description: Powered by sophisticated machine learning, we verify identity quickly and thoroughly to prevent criminals from setting up accounts.

items.title: Biometric security
items.description: Every mobile device with Revolut on it is attached to your biometrics. So if your phone is stolen, or your account is logged into on a new device, the same checks will apply.

items.title: Dedicated control centre
items.description: Personalise security settings across more than 10 features — think card controls, location-based triggers, gambling blocks, and more.

items.title: Activate cards in-app
items.description: Your physical card must be activated in your app. That’s the only place your PIN is available, too.

content.title: A-list algorithms that make spending (even) safer
content.description: If something looks suspicious, our machine learning models can pick it up. We’ll notify you and take action immediately. If we freeze your card, you can review, and unfreeze if needed.

items.title: We freeze out thieves in seconds
items.description:
Our in-house AI algorithms can flag high-risk transactions and suspicious spending patterns immediately.

We trigger proactive warnings that detect more than 95% of attempted scams. And if an unauthorised transaction gets through, you may be covered by VISA and Mastercard’s liability protection.

If you still encounter issues, our award-winning support team are on hand 24/7 to help resolve issues in minutes. Now that's peace of mind.

items.title: Superpowers for spending online
items.description: Self-destructing virtual cards mean your details are immediately deleted — and then refreshed — after each purchase, so they can’t be reused.
items.caption: Single-use virtual cards

items.title: Nothing to see here
items.description: Get a numberless physical card with just your name on it. The PAN, expiry date, and CVV are removed, and accessible in-app, for your eyes only.
items.caption: Numberless cards

items.title: Over 80% of payment fraud starts online
items.description:
If we notice anything suspicious happening when you’re shopping online, we’ll freeze your card.

For even more protection, purchase with a single-use virtual card. The card details refresh after every transaction, adding an extra layer between you and retailers you may not trust completely.

Two-factor authentication is required for sensitive transactions, and you can label vendors you use regularly as trusted, so you don’t have to approve payments every time.

content.title: Private payments to keep your info under wraps
content.description: Decide whether to hide your name or profile picture when you’re sending money to a Revolut account not in your contacts, or choose not to be discoverable at all. All your chats are encrypted, too.

items.title: Keep your finances personal
items.description: Want an extra layer of security when withdrawing from your investments? Turn on Wealth Protection to activate biometrics, our advanced facial recognition technology.
items.caption: Wealth Protection
items.footnote: Wealth Protection does not provide any guarantee or insurance against future losses in the protected accounts. Wealth Protection products may vary per country.

items.title: Guard your money on-the-go
items.description: When you’re on the move, your exposure to fraud widens. With Street Mode, you can activate delays on larger transfers outside your trusted locations, so you stay in control.
items.caption: Street Mode

items.title: Software updates
items.description: We launch app store updates regularly to stay further ahead of criminals’ latest techniques.

items.title: Cybersecurity measures
items.description: A cutting-edge prevention system, supported by an award-winning, dedicated, 24/7 Financial Crime team.

items.title: Remote access detection
items.description: If your account is accessed from an unexpected location, we’ll take action immediately.

items.title: Protect funds
items.description: As a bank, accounts are protected by the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) with up to £120,000 per person.

content.title: We’re here to help, 24/7
content.description: Whether you want to browse our Help Centre for solutions or chat to us directly, we’ve got you — even on a Sunday.

content.title: Know if it's really us
content.description: Our in-app banner lets you confirm every call is from us, stopping fraudsters in their tracks. If the call is fake, the warning is real.

items.title: I've spotted a suspicious transaction
items.description: If you’re concerned your card has been compromised, freeze your card immediately. If you believe your card has been used fraudulently, fill out a chargeback form and we’ll help you resolve the issue.

items.title: I think I've been a victim of a scam
items.description: If you think your account is at risk, immediately end any type of communication with the suspected scammer. Contact Revolut, and any other financial institution involved. Report the incident to the police.

items.title: My phone has been stolen
items.description: You can report your lost device via this webpage. Disconnect your account from the previous device. Try to use another device to log in to your account and change your passcode for security. If you're unable to log in using another device, there are a couple of ways to recover your access.

items.title: My account has been restricted
items.description: If your account is temporarily restricted, please provide the information we are requesting in-app, as this will help resolve the issue much faster. If you need help with any other issues relating to this, please get in touch with our team.

content.title: Want to learn more?
content.description: Check out these resources to build your security knowledge

items.title: Learn courses
items.description: Dive into our in-app courses to get ahead of the curve. You’ll be seeing through fraud in no time. Take the test

items.title: FAQs
items.description: Get answers on demand via our Help Centre, a virtual library packed full of answers to key questions. Visit Help Centre

Revolut Bank UK Ltd is registered in England and Wales (Registered No. 12871051). Registered address: 30 South Colonnade, London, E14 5HX. Authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and Prudential Regulation Authority (Financial Services Register No. 981170).

Revolut Ltd is registered in England and Wales (No. 08804411), is authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority to offer e-money and payment services under the Electronic Money Regulations 2011 (FRN: 900562), and is registered with the Financial Conduct Authority to offer cryptocurrency services under the Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017. Commodities services are provided by Revolut Ltd and are not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

Investment services are provided by Revolut Trading Ltd (No. 11567840), which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FRN: 933846).

The registered address of Revolut Ltd, Revolut Travel Ltd, and Revolut Trading Ltd is at 30 South Colonnade, London, United Kingdom, E14 5HX. You can read more about our terms and policies here.
